item.g:title: Atta Chakki 5HP Double Stage Pulverizer Machine
item.g:description: Our 5 HP Double Stage Pulverizer is a two-chamber grinding machine manufactured in-house. Material passes through the first chamber for coarse reduction and then through the second chamber for final fine grinding, which helps hold a consistent output mesh in a single pass. It runs at 1440 RPM and features a heavy drum structure.
item.g:product_type: Business & Industrial > Industrial Food & Beverage Equipment > Industrial Food & Beverage Milling & Processing Equipment

item.g:title: Atta Chakki 7.5HP Double Stage Pulverizer Machine
item.g:description: This machine is our workhorse for commercial spice and food grinding units. Available in 7.5HP variant. A heavier rotor assembly and larger 13"x8" and 10"x4" dual grinding chambers allow continuous running through the day, while the interchangeable sieve arrangement lets the operator change the output mesh according to the product being processed.
item.g:product_type: Business & Industrial > Industrial Food & Beverage Equipment > Industrial Food & Beverage Milling & Processing Equipment
